text:
Asha: FYI scanner flagged `vault:enc:` blobs embedded in a CI artifact archive pushed to gs://staging-artifacts/ci-outputs/2026-04-02.tar.gz.
Ethan: Do we know which pipeline produced it?
Asha: Looks like nightly/integration-tests job; runner identity is `serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
Ravi: Immediate steps: quarantine the artifact (remove public ACLs), rotate any short-lived creds stored in staging, and restrict decrypt permission on the wrapping key.
Claire: Agree. Also let's add a temporary deny binding for non-vault principals to the cryptoKey on KMS while we triage. I'll prepare the IAM delta.
Asha: Good. Can someone run a quick KMS audit query for Decrypt calls tied to that key in the last 7 days? We need principals and counts.
Ethan: Running: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=gcs_bucket AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\"' --limit 1000` -> shows 128 attempts, 3 successes from `serviceAccount:legacy-builder@partner.example.com`.
Ravi: That partner SA shouldn't have decrypt rights. Claire, please remove their role immediately and add only `serviceAccount:vault-proxy@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` + `group:secops@redwood`.
Claire: On it. Also creating new KMS key `wrap-staging-rotA` in same location and will stage a Vault transit config switch.
Asha: Rewrap approach: use Vault transit's rewrap so that plaintext never leaves Vault. We'll snapshot affected object list first. Ravi, can you own the rewrap job?
Ravi: Yes. I'll run a small pilot against `gs://staging-artifacts/ci-outputs/sample/` to validate. Pseudo: ``for f in $(gsutil ls $prefix); ct=$(gsutil cat $f | jq -r .ciphertext); vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=$ct destination_key=wrap-staging-rotA``
Ethan: Add rate limiting, please. And ensure the rewrap job logs object metadata to BigQuery for audit.
Claire: IAM change applied: removed partner SA decrypt binding. :lock: Also added logging sink to `secops_bq.kms_audit` with filter on Decrypt and IAM proto.
SecBot: Created incident INC-2026-1101, severity=medium. Playbook link: docs/security/playbooks/secrets-exposure-container.md. Assigned: Claire (KMS/IAM), Ravi (rewrap), Ethan (audit queries).
Asha: One more: update CI templates to prevent bundling credentials into tarballs. Add a step to scrub `vault:` prefixes before artifact upload.
Ethan: I'll add a pre-upload grep in the pipeline: `grep -E \"vault:enc:|vault:v[0-9]+:\" -R || true` and fail the job if match found.
Ravi: Pilot rewrap succeeded against sample; no plaintext returned. Scheduling full rewrap for +3h in a maintenance window.
Claire: After rewrap, we should revoke the old key's decrypt permission (remove all members), then rotate short-lived staging secrets. Also open PR to tighten KMS IAM so only `vault-proxy` and `secops` can decrypt.
Asha: Good plan. Post rewrap, run a global scan for `vault:` patterns across all public buckets and Artifact Registry images. I can run a quick gsutil grep across our bucket list.
Ethan: I'll create an alert rule: >50 decrypt failures from a single principal in 1h -> page. Lower threshold for external principals.
SecBot: Incident INC-2026-1101 updated: status=investigating, timeline documented in incident doc.
Asha: Thanks team. Keep updates here and paste the rewrap job logs to the incident doc when done. :white_check_mark:
